chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from Hakim ibn Jubayr al-Asadi, who said:

I heard Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) say: 'Verily, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, sends down an angel every night with him three mithqals of the musk of Paradise, and he casts it into your Euphrates. And there is no river in the east and west of the earth greater in blessing than it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the Euphrates river according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the unique spiritual status of the Euphrates (Al-Furat) as a locus of divine blessing, linking physical purity with metaphysical grace through the nightly descent of an angel carrying musk from Paradise. It serves as a foundational text for the recommended practice of prayer and ritual purification near this river, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the sanctity of specific geographical sites associated with the Ahl al-Bayt and divine favor.
